newsitem.title: USA: Gunman shoots three at McDonald's in California.
newsitem.headline: Gunman shoots three at McDonald's in California.

text.p: A lone gunman opened fire late on Thursday in a McDonald's in northern California, injuring three of the fast-food restaurant's employees, one critically, police said.

The gunman shot three female employees at close range with a small pistol, Sgt. Herman Robinson said. The incident occured at about 9:15 p.m. local time (12:15 A.M. EST) at a McDonald's in Vallejo, about 25 miles northeast of San Francisco.
One of the victims, who sustained a gunshot wound to the head, was reported in serious condition. The other two victims were stable. They were taken to local hospitals, police said.
The unidentified suspect, described by police as a black male, remained at large. Police said he left the crime scene on foot and did not steal any money from the restaurant.
A police manhunt was underway. "We have set up perimeters and have searched surrounding businesses," Robinson said.
